Cadastral map. Relief shown by hachures. Title from John R. Hébert's list of maps. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Watermark: J Whatman 1801. From the papers of Vicente Sebastián Pintado. Described in: Vicente Sebastián Pintado, Surveyor General of Spanish West Florida, 1805-17 : the man and his maps / by John R. Hébert. Imago mundi, v. 39, pp. 50-72. 1987. p. 64, no. 24. In upper left corner: Plat no 29. LC Luso-Hispanic World, 955 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
